title: Online Bidding for Contextual First-Price Auctions with Budgets under One-Sided Information Feedback
summary: In this paper, we study learning to bid in repeated first-price auctions with a hard budget constraint. We focus on one-sided information feedback: the highest competing bid is observed after a loss but remains unobserved after a win. The competing bid depends on the impression context through an unknown coefficient and additive noise with an unknown distribution. To learn this model from censored observations, we propose a regression method based on conditional quantile invariance.
